gold_sql:
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.geometry
  FROM pois p
  WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-85.92361 37.225846)',4326)::geography, 4100)
    AND p.leisure = 'golf_course'
),
poi_elev AS (
  SELECT c.id, elev.z
  FROM candidates c
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, c.geometry::geometry) AS z
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, c.geometry::geometry)
    LIMIT 1
  ) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM poi_elev
WHERE z <= 400;

WITH safari_park AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-85.92361 37.225846)'), 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
buffered_area AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(safari_park.geom, 4100) AS geom
  FROM safari_park
),
dem_clip AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM
    public.dem_us
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM buffered_area))
),
elevation_filtered AS (
  SELECT
    (rast).val AS elevation,
    (rast).geom AS pixel_geom
  FROM
    dem_clip,
    LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1)
  WHERE
    (rast).val <= 400
),
golf_courses AS (
  SELECT
    ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-85.430326 37.789703)'), 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
golf_courses_in_area AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM
    golf_courses
  WHERE
    ST_Contains((SELECT geom FROM buffered_area), geom)
    AND ST_Contains((SELECT geom FROM elevation_filtered), geom)
)
SELECT count FROM golf_courses_in_area;
